meta.name: dhdna-profiler
meta.description: Extract cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text. Use this skill when the user wants to analyze how someone thinks, understand cognitive style, profile writing or speech patterns, compare thinking styles between people, asks "what's my thinking style", "analyze how this person reasons", "cognitive profile", "thinking pattern", "DHDNA", "digital DNA", or wants to understand the mind behind any text. Also trigger when the user provides text and wants deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns, decision-making style, or cognitive signature.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析任意文本中的认知模式与思维指纹
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解自己或他人的思考方式和认知风格
copy.tagline_en: Analyze cognitive patterns and thinking fingerprints from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand the thinking style and cognitive signature behind any text

howto.what: 分析任意文本,提取作者认知特征:按12个维度各打1–10分,并输出张力图、主导/阴影模式、推理拓扑、决策指纹、叙述总结和关键引语;可对比多个作者,也可基于对话历史分析用户自身。
howto.when: 当你说出“我的思考风格”、“分析这个人如何推理”、“认知档案”等表示想了解文本背后的推理方式时,或提供文本要求深入分析作者思维时触发。

say.text: 分析这段文字,给我认知档案。
say.note: 会按12个维度评分并输出完整档案。

say.text: 用DHDNA比较我和他的思考方式。
say.note: 会分别出档案再对比趋同与分歧点。

say.text: 看看这封邮件的作者是怎么思考的。
say.note: 会提取推理拓扑和决策指纹。

howto.what_en: Analyzes texts to extract the author's cognitive signature: scores 12 dimensions (1–10), outputs tension map, dominant/shadow patterns, reasoning topology, decision fingerprint, narrative synthesis, key quotes; compares multiple authors or profiles the user from chat history.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about thinking style, cognitive profile, how someone reasons, or provide text wanting deeper insight into the author's reasoning patterns.

say_en.text: Analyze this text and give me a cognitive profile.
say_en.note: Scores 12 dimensions and produces the full profile.

say_en.text: Compare his thinking style with mine using DHDNA.
say_en.note: Profiles each, then compares convergences and gaps.

say_en.text: How does the writer of this email think?
say_en.note: Extracts reasoning topology and decision fingerprint.
